abstract: OBJECTIVE: To characterize the sonographic patterns of teratomas located within the mediastinum and to correlate them with pathologic findings, because there have been few reports concerning the application of sonography in the diagnosis of mediastinal teratoma. METHODS: Over a 9-year period, we carried out an image analysis of the sonographic findings of 28 mediastinal teratomas whose diagnoses were proved surgically. RESULTS: Sonography showed that 18 patients had a complex mass of heterogeneous echogenicity, including regional bright echoes (n = 12), acoustic shadows (n = 8), hyperechoic lines and dots (n = 7), soft tissue septa (n = 9), dermoid plugs (n = 6), and hypoechoic areas (n = 11). This type of mediastinal teratoma revealed, in pathologic findings, varying combinations of fat, sebaceous and mucinous materials, hair, mineralized elements, and multiple compartments. Eight patients had a homogeneous hyperechoic mass, and the 2 remaining patients had floating spherules within a cystic mass. Pathologically, the homogeneous mass mainly contained hair and sebaceous material. The floating spherules were also composed of sebaceous tissue and were above the fluid of the cyst. CONCLUSIONS: On the basis of the evaluation of the sonographic and pathologic findings, we described 3 major patterns of mediastinal teratoma: a complex mass of heterogeneous echogenicity, homogeneous high echogenicity within a solid mass, and floating spherules within a cystic mass. Thus, sonography can improve the diagnosis of mediastinal teratoma. However, additional prospective studies are needed to test the sensitivity and specificity of these sonographic patterns in the diagnosis of mediastinal teratoma.
abstract_ja: 目的：縦隔に生じた奇形腫の超音波所見の型を特徴づけ、病理所見と対比すること。奇形腫の超音波診断への応用に関する報告はわずかであるため。方法：9年間に外科的に診断が確定した縦隔奇形腫28例について、超音波画像を後方視的に解析した。結果：18例では、不均一な高エコーを伴う複雑な腫瘤を呈し、その内訳は局所的な高輝度エコー（12例）、音響陰影（8例）、高エコーの線状・点状構造（7例）、軟部組織性の隔壁（9例）、皮脂栓（6例）、低エコー域（11例）であった。この型の奇形腫では、病理学的には脂肪、皮脂、粘液性物質、毛髪、石灰化成分、多房性構造などの様々な組み合わせが認められた。8例は均一な高エコー腫瘤を呈し、残る2例は嚢胞性腫瘤内に浮遊する球状物を認めた。病理学的には、均一な腫瘤は主に毛髪と皮脂性物質を含んでいた。浮遊球は同様に皮脂組織から成り、嚢胞液の上方に位置していた。結論：超音波所見と病理所見の評価に基づき、縦隔奇形腫の3つの主要な型を記載した：不均一な高エコーの複雑な腫瘤、固形腫瘤内の均一な高エコー、嚢胞性腫瘤内の浮遊球。このように超音波検査は縦隔奇形腫の診断を向上させうる。ただし、これらの超音波パターンの診断感度・特異度を検証するため、さらなる前向き研究が必要である。
